title: Trainer runaway orphan proc (pid 2400542 python3 -) killed; remote timeout added to trainer-vm-diag
note: 2026-10-15: orphan 'bash -s'(ppid 1)+'python3 -' started 2026-10-12 11:12Z, ~66% CPU on 1-OCPU trainer, killed via trainer-vm-diag #18269 (guard on pid/start/cmd; both gone). Source workflow NOT identified (env lacked UNIT/RUN_ID; no stdin script recoverable). Hypothesis (unverified): relay ssh died on cancel/60min cap, no-tty remote bash -s survived. Fix: remote 'timeout --kill-after=30 3540 bash -s' in trainer-vm-diag.yml (PR pending). Closes when: no python3 - / bash -s orphan with ppid 1 and etimes>3600 on trainer in next health pull, and heavy-lock waits drop. Load after kill still ~2.1 (drift-retrain ~47% CPU is legit); the 70min backtest_ict_scalp heavy-lock hold is separate, unaddressed.  | 2026-10-15 follow-up: same remote 'timeout --kill-after=30 <cap> bash -s' wrapper applied to trainer-diag-relay (3540), trainer-capture-watch (5340), health-snapshot (840), each under its job timeout-minutes. Heavy lock is runtime_logs/trainer/.heavy.lock (0-byte flock; holder found via ps) per manager.

writeback.roadmap: none: L-OPS trainer hygiene only; no milestone line changes
writeback.arch: none: relay hardening; no architecture change

observation.what: No orphaned bash -s / python3 - (ppid 1, etimes>3600) on the trainer after PR #18271 is deployed
observation.how_to_check: trainer-vm-diag: ps -eo pid,ppid,etimes,cmd | awk '$2==1 && $3>3600 && /bash -s|python3 -$/' -> must be empty; trainer load average no longer ~2 with only one ml job running
